title: Post game
note: The black outro of about 3 s: the End phase fades to black (0.4 s; a cut under reduced motion), plays one sound for the win and one for the loss (the cops' end with a siren, m8 §6), routes no voice (#213) and returns everyone to the lobby after 3 s (#212). Nobody hears anybody and no text says so. No input. Three ends (m8 §6; the sketch pages/mvp-screens frames 10 to 12 at 0.75). Open: whether the end reveals who was human, and whether it shows the points (today it names only the winner).

states.label: Прибульці перемогли
states.note: An alien's view: every task done before the timer and the cops (the sketch's frame 10). The own side won: the winner on the result plate.

states.label: Час вийшов
states.note: A human's view: the timer ran out with the tasks unfinished (frame 11). The own side won: the plate.

states.label: Копи приїхали
states.note: An alien's view: the cops' minute ran out (frame 12). The own side lost: the winner in plain text, no plate (the decided rule: the plate is for a win).

nodes.name: Night
nodes.note: P2, opaque: the full screens' base ground (ui-2.0.0). The cops' end fills the whole screen with the danger colour in the target page (ToyBackdropAlert, ToyTextOnDanger): open for the game, the screen here keeps the base under the danger band. It fades in over 0.4 s when the End phase starts (a cut under reduced motion).

nodes.name: V
nodes.note: A centred column on the night, 32 px between its lines (the sketch's 20 x 1.5 = 30, the nearest step).

children.name: Band
children.note: ui-2.0.0 (the target page, frame 10): the loud band across the whole width, 315 px tall (210 x 1.5): the accent when the aliens won, the danger colour when the humans did.

children.name: Title
children.note: How the party ended, in Unbounded at the hero size on the band, the same for every player: end.title.party (the accent ink), end.title.time_up or end.title.busted (the danger ink).

children.name: Winner
children.note: When the own side won: the winning side on the result plate.

children.name: WinnerLoss
children.note: When the own side lost: the winning side in plain text, no plate. end.won_aliens or end.won_humans.

children.name: Reason
children.note: Why the round ended, from the host's reason id (#208), on a word tile: an accent outline when the aliens won, a danger outline when the humans did. An unknown reason hides it.

children.name: Text
children.note: end.reason.all_tasks with the round's time (m:ss), end.reason.time_up, or end.reason.cops.

children.name: Gap
children.note: With the column's two 32 px gaps, 76 px between the reason and the countdown.

children.name: Back
children.note: Counts 3, 2, 1 once a second; at 0 everyone is back in the lobby, the aliens' ship (#212). Open: how the return to the ship looks.
